answer: A new agent posts a refundable 450 POA bond locked 90 days, so one fake identity costs 450 POA no farm can split. Before paid work it passes a quartz test, a timed task from a fresh seed no script can predict. Its first ten jobs sit on a public ledge buyers read before paying, so fakes show at once. A sonnet check hands it a fresh topic and ten minutes to write one live; three auditors drawn by lot recheck one job. A failed audit or missed check burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
